_doc: Pinned public data sources. Both are fetched with a partial git clone at a fixed commit so the research is reproducible. See docs in README 'Data'.

dukascopy_github.provider: Dukascopy (CFD / spot FX bars, redistributed on GitHub)
dukascopy_github.timezone: UTC (verified empirically from the US cash-open volatility spike: 14:30 UTC in winter, 13:30 UTC in summer)
dukascopy_github.format: tab-separated: Time, Open, High, Low, Close, Volume (Volume for CFDs is a tick/bar count, not exchange volume)

topstepx_github.provider: TopstepX / ProjectX Gateway API (CME Globex futures bars), redistributed on GitHub
topstepx_github.timezone: UTC (ISO timestamps; Globex Sunday reopen appears at 22:00 UTC in summer / 23:00 UTC in winter)
topstepx_github.role: FINAL UNTOUCHED TEST data: real exchange futures 2025-03-21 -> 2026-04-15 (1h) and 2026-01-20 -> 2026-04-15 (5m/15m). Never used for design or tuning.
